settings.banner_heading: Better quality, smarter design and modular solutions without the premium price.

settings.title: Modular By Design
settings.text: One of the biggest things we noticed when shopping for tool storage was that most systems were designed as finished products. Buy it. Put it in your shop. That's it. But that's not how people work. Your tools grow. Your business grows. Your workspace changes. The way you work changes. That's why we built TOOSA around modularity. Start with what you need today and build from there. Add storage. Add a hutch. Add a side locker. Add accessories. Change your configuration. Your workspace doesn't have to stay the same just because your tool cabinet does.

settings.title: We Listen. Then We Build
settings.text: Our products are shaped by the people who use them. A big part of what makes TOOSA different is that our products don't just come from a product development meeting. They come from conversations with our customers. We pay attention to what people like, what they don't like, and what they wish their workspace could do differently.

settings.title: Designed From Real Feedback
settings.text: Customers told us that traditional sliding hutch doors could get in the way of the work surface and limit visibility when open. So we changed the design. Our hutch doors wrap back instead of sliding across the workspace, creating a more open, accessible, and better-lit work area. Customers also asked us for integrated side lockers for our 72" systems. So we designed them to seamlessly integrate with both new and existing TOOSA cabinets including interchangeable doors and a removable side panel that allows access to the cabinet's power bar when installed on the appropriate side. These aren't features we added because they sounded good on a spec sheet. They came from people actually using our products. And that's how we want to keep building TOOSA.

settings.title: Canadian Company. Local Support
settings.text: Global manufacturing. Canadian service. TOOSA is a Vancouver-based Canadian company. Our products are manufactured overseas through carefully selected manufacturing partners. This allows us to maintain the quality and features we want while keeping our prices accessible to Canadian customers. But our relationship with our customers doesn't end when a product leaves the factory. We have boots on the ground in Canada providing assembly services, lighting-kit preparation, spare parts, after-sales support, and customer service. We believe you shouldn't have to choose between affordable pricing and having someone here who actually cares when you need help.

settings.title: 1,000+ Customers And Counting
settings.text: From one Marketplace listing to a growing Canadian community. TOOSA was founded by two friends who have known each other for more than 18 years. We had always talked about starting a business together. TOOSA gave us the opportunity to finally do it. Since launching in February 2024, we've grown from one Marketplace listing into a community of 1,000+ customers across Canada. And honestly, that's one of the things we're most proud of. Not just the number. It's seeing the garages, shops, fabrication spaces, businesses, and projects our customers have built around their TOOSA systems. Every new customer becomes part of the TOOSA family and every customer gives us another opportunity to make the products better.

settings.title: What's Next?
settings.text: We're just getting started. We don't want TOOSA to be just another tool cabinet company. We're building a broader ecosystem of modular workspace and shop solutions designed around the people who use them. Tool storage is where we started. But as our customers' needs evolve, so will we. From storage and workspaces to organization, equipment, and accessories, our goal is simple: Help people build better workspaces. Whether you're setting up your first home garage, running a professional shop, or growing a business, we want TOOSA to give you the flexibility to build a workspace that works for you. ## Build your workspace. Your way. TOOSA

settings.eyebrow: We love tools. We just don't like losing them.
settings.heading: Why Trust Us?
settings.description: At TOOSA, we believe a well-designed workspace should make your work easier, more organized, and more efficient. Our products are built around the way people actually work — whether that means repairing equipment, fabricating parts, maintaining vehicles, or taking on projects at home. We focus on practical design, durable construction, and keeping the tools you rely on within easy reach. Everything we build comes back to three principles: Quality. Value. Flexibility. We want our customers to feel confident in what they’re buying, which is why we focus on products that are built to work hard, priced fairly, and designed to adapt as your needs change.
